finding: D-1.1b 429 arm ends the chain on every RateLimitError, not the token-limit class
reasoning_trace: Read the except RateLimitError arm; it tests only _ceiling_unverified. RateLimitError is raised bare on any 429 (anthropic_adapter.py:343,489). e2e test at test_ceiling_e2e.py:247 pins a classless 429.
remediation: Classify the 429 in the adapter (token_limited) and short-circuit only on that class; request-rate 429 walks.

finding: _ceiling_unverified computed once from the head entry and applied to every fallback hop
reasoning_trace: Flag assigned in pre-flight branch, read at 2256 and 2297 inside the walk loop, never recomputed per hop.
remediation: Compute _hop_unverified per hop from input_bound(_hop_entry, ...) and use it at both arms.

finding: record_observed has no inter-process lock; concurrent writers lose provider verdicts
reasoning_trace: load (279) -> append (290) -> mkstemp+os.replace (294-299) with no flock; Flatline/adversarial review write concurrently; review repro retained 26-30 of 100 rows.
remediation: fcntl.flock on <store>.lock (O_NOFOLLOW) around load/append/replace; multi-writer test.

finding: Bridgebuilder default model is alias 'opus' with no token-budget row
reasoning_trace: truncation.generated.ts keys are concrete ids; no GENERATED_MODEL_ALIASES exported anywhere under pr/head; getTokenBudget('opus') -> default row; effectiveInputBudget returns raw 200K > 180K probed bound. Snapshot's later truncation.ts adds exactly this alias resolution.
remediation: Emit GENERATED_MODEL_ALIASES from gen-bb-registry.ts and resolve before lookup; add alias tests.

finding: Provider-stated numbers and broad markers poison the persistent input bound (self-DoS of a model)
reasoning_trace: Traced provider 400/413 body -> is_context_limit_message (11 substrings) -> parse_context_limit -> ProviderContextLimitError -> _calibration_needed_exit -> record_observed with no plausibility check; observed_for/min -> input_bound observed-1 for every later call until calibrated. No-number case stores cheval's own estimate. Confirmed by DISS-C-001.
remediation: Bound-check limit in [FLOOR, context_window] and input_tokens vs estimate; positive regex match before lowering; never store estimate as observed; tamper test.

finding: Long-context threshold ignores cache_read/cache_creation tokens; budget cap under-fires
reasoning_trace: input_tokens excludes cache tokens per ledger.py:133; cached long-context runs billed at base rate and never flagged long_context. Confirmed by DISS-C-003.
remediation: Compare input+cache_read+cache_creation against threshold.

finding: _mult accepts inf; OverflowError in post_call turns a billed completion into API_ERROR and drops the ledger row
reasoning_trace: float('inf')>0 passes; int(cost*inf) raises at :171 inside budget_hook.post_call within the walk-loop try. Multipliers <1 also accepted. Confirmed by DISS-C-005.
remediation: math.isfinite(m) and m>=1.0; tests for .inf/nan/1e309/0.5.

finding: One-shot shrink lost on the final attempt; oversize payload walked as RetriesExhaustedError
reasoning_trace: continue inside for attempt in range(max_retries+1) without setting last_typed_error; with max_retries 0 the shrunk request is never sent; cheval walks RetriesExhaustedError.
remediation: Shrink outside the attempt counter or re-raise when no attempt remains; set last_typed_error.

finding: Non-Anthropic output default 4096->16K while I1 fit runs only for ceiling-bearing entries; adapter refuses prompts that fit before
reasoning_trace: default_max_tokens caps non-Anthropic at 16K; cheval.py:2078 fit requires effective_input_ceiling/probed_ceiling; enforce_context_window then rejects estimate+16000>window.
remediation: Apply I1 to every hop with a context_window, or keep 4096 without a ceiling.

finding: Gate uses the provider count, adapter's enforce_context_window still uses chars/3.5
reasoning_trace: _walk_estimate replaced by count; base.py:1019 unchanged in diff; heuristic overcount near the window refuses an approved request.
remediation: Pass the gate estimate into the adapter or accept an override.

finding: 64000 voice cap ignores LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING (16K default, 600 s read timeout)
reasoning_trace: flatline_voice_max_tokens caps at 64000 regardless of transport; non-streaming timeout ~15K tokens.
remediation: Cap at transport default or pass no --max-tokens under the kill switch.

finding: Calibration exit records str(_exc) without sanitize_provider_error_message (defence in depth)
reasoning_trace: Adapter sanitises via _extract_error_message (anthropic_adapter.py:791-810); RateLimitError carries no body; dissent-cited test does not exist. Downgraded from DISS-001/DISS-C-002.
remediation: Sanitise at the recording site.

finding: Beta-header allowlist: \d matches Unicode digits, re.match+$ admits trailing newline
reasoning_trace: Regex read; HTTP clients refuse CR/LF so no injection, but ConfigError promise not kept. Confirmed by DISS-C-004.
remediation: [0-9] and re.fullmatch.

finding: Model id spliced into yq expression; jq min null drops provider_limit-only rows; 0 row renders observed -1
reasoning_trace: Catalog-sourced id (operator trust); jq expression read.
remediation: strenv for the id; handle null/0 in the min.

finding: MODEL_MAX_OUTPUT interpolates the YAML key unescaped into sourced bash
reasoning_trace: Same raw pattern as 8 pre-existing arrays; key not guarded while value is. Confirmed by DISS-C-006.
remediation: @sh quoting or key allowlist in the generator.

finding: Observed-store env path accepts symlink/non-regular and creates any parent, unlike resolve_cost_ledger_path
reasoning_trace: os.replace replaces the link (no write-through); inconsistent rules between two state writers.
remediation: Reuse ledger path resolution rules.

finding: --write-catalog leaves model-config.yaml at mode 0600 (mkstemp)
reasoning_trace: mkstemp 0600 + os.replace drops the original mode.
remediation: copymode before replace.

finding: Multipliers applied to floored per-category costs; remainders not recomputed
reasoning_trace: 3 tok x 1.25 x 1.5 bills 4, exact floor 5.
remediation: floor(tokens*rate*mult/1e6) per category.

finding: 'too many tokens' marker also matches Bedrock throttle text
reasoning_trace: Only Anthropic 400/413 reach it today.
remediation: Throttle markers outrank context markers.

finding: estimator.method reports tiktoken whenever the module imports
reasoning_trace: Method set by import success, not by use.
remediation: Report the method estimate_tokens actually used.

finding: max_tokens shrunk notice hidden behind warn branch; fallback-hop shrink silent
reasoning_trace: elif after warn; 2105-2109 writes only the envelope field. Confirmed by review DISS-C-006.
remediation: Print the shrink line independently and on fallback hops.

finding: Health probe falls back to a message only on exactly 404
reasoning_trace: 403/405/501 from a proxy report healthy deployment as down.
remediation: Fall back on any 4xx other than 401/403-auth.

finding: CLI-hop calibrate hint names claude-headless, which write_catalog refuses
reasoning_trace: Observation recorded against an entry with no HTTP ceiling.
remediation: Skip the hint/record for CLI hops.

finding: cmd_invoke grows ~250 lines; 50-line closure over eleven enclosing names
reasoning_trace: Nesting where ARCH-001 hid.
remediation: Extract to module-level helpers taking the state dict.
